name: FAB (First Abu Dhabi Bank)
verdict: Abu Dhabi's state fund Mubadala is First Abu Dhabi Bank's largest shareholder, with 37.9%.
note: The UAE's largest bank, listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange; on the chest, sleeves and side panels of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG kit. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Mubadala, wholly owned by the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, holds 37.9% (30 June 2026); FAB's share profile also lists the 'Abu Dhabi ruling family' with 17.7%, each holder below 5%. The UAE's record is on main (uae-mass-trial-2024, mubadala-uae-convictions-upheld).
